soru: Bulut hizmetlerinde olay yönetimi için kök neden analizi (hata konumlandırma, nedensellik çıkarımı) yöntemleri üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Bulut hizmetlerinde olay yönetimi için kök neden analizi (hata konumlandırma, nedensellik çıkarımı) yöntemleri üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2025-09-22. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first), each with its arXiv id and/or DOI. You may search the web.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Causal Inference-Based Root Cause Analysis for Online Service Systems with Intervention Recognition
calismalar.gerekce: CIRCA treats root cause analysis as recognizing an intervention in a structural causal model, and it became a theoretical reference point for causal RCA.

calismalar.baslik: Root Cause Analysis of Failures in Microservices through Causal Discovery
calismalar.gerekce: RCD models a failure as an intervention and learns only the part of the causal graph near the root cause, which made causal-discovery RCA scale to larger systems.

calismalar.baslik: MicroRCA: Root Cause Localization of Performance Issues in Microservices
calismalar.gerekce: It set the standard baseline for locating root causes with an attributed graph and personalized PageRank.

calismalar.baslik: Automatic Root Cause Analysis via Large Language Models for Cloud Incidents
calismalar.gerekce: RCACopilot is an industrial system that uses LLMs for root cause analysis of cloud incidents at Microsoft.

calismalar.baslik: Recommending Root-Cause and Mitigation Steps for Cloud Incidents using Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: It was the first large-scale empirical study of using LLMs for root-cause and mitigation recommendations on cloud incidents.

calismalar.baslik: Sage: Practical and Scalable ML-Driven Performance Debugging in Microservices
calismalar.gerekce: It locates root causes without supervision by combining a causal Bayesian network with counterfactual reasoning.

calismalar.baslik: CloudRanger: Root Cause Identification for Cloud Native Systems
calismalar.gerekce: It was one of the first works to apply PC-based causal graph construction and random-walk RCA to cloud-native systems.

calismalar.baslik: Localizing Failure Root Causes in a Microservice through Causality Inference
calismalar.gerekce: MicroCause localizes root causes with a time-lagged causal graph built by the PCTS algorithm.

calismalar.baslik: Eadro: An End-to-End Troubleshooting Framework for Microservices on Multi-source Data
calismalar.gerekce: It handles anomaly detection and root cause localization together over logs, metrics and traces.

calismalar.baslik: Actionable and Interpretable Fault Localization for Recurring Failures in Online Service Systems
calismalar.gerekce: DejaVu brings interpretable, graph-neural-network-based fault localization to recurring failures.

calismalar.baslik: MicroRank: End-to-End Latency Issue Localization with Extended Spectrum Analysis in Microservice Environments
calismalar.gerekce: It brought trace-based spectrum analysis and PageRank into microservice root cause analysis.

calismalar.baslik: Practical Root Cause Localization for Microservice Systems via Trace Analysis
calismalar.gerekce: TraceRCA is a practical method that localizes root causes by mining frequent patterns in traces.

calismalar.baslik: Nezha: Interpretable Fine-Grained Root Causes Analysis for Microservices on Multi-modal Observability Data
calismalar.gerekce: It offers interpretable root cause analysis at code and resource level using multimodal event patterns.

calismalar.baslik: Groot: An Event-graph-based Approach for Root Cause Analysis in Industrial Settings
calismalar.gerekce: It is an event-graph RCA system deployed at industrial scale (eBay).

calismalar.baslik: RCAgent: Cloud Root Cause Analysis by Autonomous Agents with Tool-Augmented Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: It is a tool-augmented, autonomous LLM agent for cloud root cause analysis, deployed at Alibaba Cloud.

calismalar.baslik: Root Cause Analysis for Microservices based on Causal Inference: How Far Are We?
calismalar.gerekce: This large-scale benchmark of causal RCA methods exposes their weaknesses and the open problems.

calismalar.baslik: BARO: Robust Root Cause Analysis for Microservices via Multivariate Bayesian Online Change Point Detection
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that a simple, robust change-point approach can match or beat complex causal methods.

calismalar.baslik: RCAEval: A Benchmark for Root Cause Analysis of Microservice Systems with Telemetry Data
calismalar.gerekce: It provides the open benchmark and evaluation framework the field needed.

calismalar.baslik: OpenRCA: Can Large Language Models Locate the Root Cause of Software Failures?
calismalar.gerekce: This ICLR 2025 benchmark shows how far LLMs still are from realistic root cause analysis.

calismalar.baslik: AIOpsLab: A Holistic Framework to Evaluate AI Agents for Enabling Autonomous Clouds
calismalar.gerekce: It is a framework for evaluating AI agents end to end on detection, localization and root cause analysis of cloud incidents.

calismalar.baslik: A Comprehensive Survey on Root Cause Analysis in (Micro) Services: Methodologies, Challenges, and Trends
calismalar.gerekce: This survey classifies microservice RCA methods and sets out the open problems.

calismalar.baslik: A Survey of AIOps Methods for Failure Management
calismalar.gerekce: It is a foundational survey that systematically classifies AIOps methods for failure management, including root cause analysis.

calismalar.baslik: Towards Intelligent Incident Management: Why We Need It and How We Make It
calismalar.gerekce: It defines the incident management lifecycle and its challenges in industrial cloud services.

calismalar.baslik: Seer: Leveraging Big Data to Navigate the Complexity of Performance Debugging in Cloud Microservices
calismalar.gerekce: It is early, influential work on predicting QoS violations in microservices with deep learning.

calismalar.baslik: An Open-Source Benchmark Suite for Microservices and Their Hardware-Software Implications for Cloud & Edge Systems
calismalar.gerekce: DeathStarBench is the standard microservice testbed used in most RCA evaluations.

calismalar.baslik: Interdependent Causal Networks for Root Cause Localization
calismalar.gerekce: REASON localizes root causes with hierarchical graph neural network causal discovery across interdependent networks.

calismalar.baslik: Incremental Causal Graph Learning for Online Root Cause Analysis
calismalar.gerekce: CORAL addresses online root cause analysis by updating the causal graph incrementally.

calismalar.baslik: Generic and Robust Localization of Multi-dimensional Root Causes
calismalar.gerekce: Squeeze is an important method for localizing root causes in multidimensional KPI attributes.

calismalar.baslik: MicroHECL: High-Efficient Root Cause Localization in Large-Scale Microservice Systems
calismalar.gerekce: It is an efficient root cause localization method based on a service dependency graph, deployed at Alibaba scale.

calismalar.baslik: PyRCA: A Library for Metric-based Root Cause Analysis
calismalar.gerekce: It is an open-source library that brings metric-based causal RCA methods under one roof and makes them reproducible.
